meta_description:
89K likes, 494 comments - alygoni on October 9, 2026: "I’ve bought plenty of jewellery off and I’ll keep doing it. But today reminded me what a store does differently.

At @ramanta.co in Rajkot, they handed me a silver piece, told me how it was made, and then just let me sit with it. The watch, a chain I didn’t plan on, the red one I kept going back to. This family has been working with silver for three generations and you hear it in how they talk about it, not only in how they make it.

Check out their lovely silver pieces at @ramanta.co @ramanta.store 

#Alygoni #Ramanta #Rajkot #925silverjewellery".
